description: Smoke test of the campus-customs MCP server, called from the vibe coder (Claude Code desktop) after the server was connected through .mcp.json and approved in .claude/settings.local.json. Each tool was called once through MCP, then its output was checked with a read-only query against data/campus_customs_new.db.

tests.prompt: Use the campus-customs tool check_stock to check CC-HOOD-NAVY in size M for 20 units (ticket 103).
tests.prompt_entered_by: user, typed word for word in the vibe coder; the rerun gave the same output as below

db_check.notes: Size M qty 8 = qty_on_hand. 20 - 8 = 12 = shortfall. Other sizes L 14, S 4, XL 6 match.

tests.prompt: Use the campus-customs tool check_vendor_invoices for vendor 1 (ticket 101, invoice 501).
tests.prompt_entered_by: user, typed word for word in the vibe coder; the rerun gave the same output as below

tool_output.blocked_reason: Bulldog Print Co has 1 open unpaid invoice(s); they will not ship until paid.

db_check.notes: Vendor name, specialty and lead_days match. Invoice 501 is the only invoice for vendor 1: amount 840, due 2026-08-28, status open. 2026-08-31 minus 2026-08-28 = 3 days overdue. Open invoice exists, so will_ship = false (shop rule).

tests.prompt: Use the campus-customs tool get_lease_rent_status for lease 1 (ticket 102).
tests.prompt_entered_by: user, typed word for word in the vibe coder; the rerun gave the same output as below

db_check.notes: Space, landlord, rent 2400 and next_due 2026-09-02 match. 2026-09-02 minus 2026-08-31 = 2 days until due, so not overdue.

result: 3 of 3 tools passed: every tool output matches data/campus_customs_new.db.
